notice.title: UGC Fee Refund Policy 2024-25 (D.O. No.F.2-71/2022 (CPP-II) (C-114546), 12 June 2024), continued for 2025-26 by D.O.No.F.12-5/2024(FNT/NET)-FeeNivaran(Notice), 27 October 2025, which attaches the October 2018 UGC Notification on Refund of Fees and Non-Retention of Original Certificates
notice.number_or_date: 12 June 2024 (policy); 27 October 2025 (continuation for 2025-26); tiers table from October 2018 notification, Clause 4.1.3
notice.locator: Page 4 of 18, 2018 notification Clause 4.1.3 (scanned; read from page image). Notice p.1; 12 June 2024 letter para 3(d) reproduces the same table.

tiers.label: 100% refund of fees (point of time when notice of withdrawal is received in the HEI)
tiers.window: 15 days or more before the formally-notified last date of admission
tiers.note: Processing charge: HEI may deduct up to 5% of fees paid, max Rs 5,000 (Cl. 4.1.4, applies to tier (1) only).

tiers.label: 90% refund of fees (point of time when notice of withdrawal is received in the HEI)
tiers.window: Less than 15 days before the formally-notified last date of admission
tiers.note: Day bounds are an integer reading of the printed wording; 'last date' day itself assumed in this tier.

tiers.label: 80% refund of fees (point of time when notice of withdrawal is received in the HEI)
tiers.window: 15 days or less after the formally-notified last date of admission

tiers.label: 50% refund of fees (point of time when notice of withdrawal is received in the HEI)
tiers.window: 30 days or less, but more than 15 days, after formally-notified last date of admission

tiers.label: 0% refund of fees (point of time when notice of withdrawal is received in the HEI)
tiers.window: More than 30 days after formally-notified last date of admission

tiers.label: Full refund (2024-25 session special rule)
tiers.note: Absolute calendar date in the 12 June 2024 letter, anchor not relative; applies to session 2024-25. Not used for later sessions.

tiers.label: Refund less processing fee (2024-25 session special rule)
tiers.window: deduction of not more than Rs. 1,000 as processing fee, up to 31 October 2024
tiers.note: Absolute date; refund percent printed as full refund minus up to Rs 1,000.

aicte_note: Not determined. AICTE page 'Notice on AICTE Refund Policy' (aicte.gov.in/content/notice-aicte-refund-policy, 2018) is only about payments by institutions to AICTE through its portal, not student fee refunds (page not retained: aicte.gov.in is outside the approved source domains). Student refund rules are in the AICTE Approval Process Handbook (clause reportedly 6.45), which could not be fetched; aicte-india.org failed TLS handshake (not bypassed).
unverified: AICTE student withdrawal refund rules not verified from an official document; secondary sources only, not used.

No UGC fee refund policy specific to 2026-27 found; UGC letter dated 7 Oct 2026 (published 22/10/2026 on ugc.gov.in, saved as ugc_letter_2026-10-22_noncompliance_fee_refund.pdf) is an enforcement request that lists 12 June 2024 as the latest policy circular. Treat 2018 tiers as in force for 2026-27 admission schedules beyond 31 Oct only if UGC has not issued a newer policy; not confirmed.
Processing deduction: Rs 5,000 cap is 5% of fees paid, max Rs 5,000, tier (1) only; 2024-25 special rule says Rs 1,000 up to 31 Oct 2024.
Tier day bounds are an integer reading of printed wording; 'last date of admission' is institution-notified per HEI, not a fixed date.
Return timeline: 'within fifteen days from the date of receiving a written application' (Cl. 4.1.5, page 5 of the PDF text layer).
